import { Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { Job } from 'bullmq';

interface UnsupportedPayload {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly enabled: boolean;
}

@Injectable()
class UnsupportedWorkService {
  async run(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async safe(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async prepare(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async other(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
}

// B0_CASE:alias-unsupported
@Processor('alias-jobs')
class AliasProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(private readonly work: UnsupportedWorkService) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<UnsupportedPayload, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    // B0_NEGATIVE:aliased-discriminant
    const jobName = job.name;
    switch (jobName) {
      case 'aliased':
        await this.work.run(job.data.id);
        return;
      default:
        return;
    }
  }
}

// B0_CASE:mutation-unsupported
@Processor('mutated-jobs')
class MutationProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(private readonly work: UnsupportedWorkService) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<UnsupportedPayload, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    // B0_NEGATIVE:mutated-discriminant
    (job as { name: string }).name = 'rewritten';
    if (job.name === 'rewritten') await this.work.run(job.data.id);
  }
}

// B0_CASE:compound-unsupported
@Processor('compound-jobs')
class CompoundProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(private readonly work: UnsupportedWorkService) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<UnsupportedPayload, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    // B0_NEGATIVE:compound-predicate
    if (job.name === 'compound' && job.data.enabled) {
      await this.work.run(job.data.id);
    }
  }
}

// B0_CASE:fallthrough-partial
@Processor('fallthrough-jobs')
class FallthroughProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(private readonly work: UnsupportedWorkService) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<UnsupportedPayload, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    switch (job.name) {
      // B0_BRANCH:fallthrough-safe-exact
      case 'safe':
        await this.work.safe(job.data.id);
        return;
      // B0_NEGATIVE:nonempty-fallthrough
      case 'prepare':
        await this.work.prepare(job.data.id);
      case 'other':
        await this.work.other(job.data.id);
        return;
      default:
        return;
    }
  }
}

// B0_CASE:dynamic-case-partial
@Processor('dynamic-case-jobs')
class DynamicCaseProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(private readonly work: UnsupportedWorkService) {
    super();
  }

  private dynamicJobName(): string {
    return 'runtime-selected';
  }

  async process(job: Job<UnsupportedPayload, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    switch (job.name) {
      // B0_BRANCH:dynamic-case-safe-exact
      case 'safe':
        await this.work.safe(job.data.id);
        return;
      // B0_NEGATIVE:dynamic-case-label
      case this.dynamicJobName():
        await this.work.other(job.data.id);
        return;
      default:
        return;
    }
  }
}

@Module({
  providers: [
    UnsupportedWorkService,
    AliasProcessor,
    MutationProcessor,
    CompoundProcessor,
    FallthroughProcessor,
    DynamicCaseProcessor,
  ],
})
class UnsupportedModule {}

const __B0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('B0 BullMQ fixture must never execute: unsupported');
})();
void __B0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
